answer: One defense is a lineage bond: every agent stakes a small copper-denominated deposit to register, and each identity it spawns draws from that same deposit rather than minting a fresh one. Registration requires a random hardware challenge, so a thousand sock-puppet agents crowded on one ledge of shared servers expose themselves when the challenge returns identical fingerprints. Honest operators, whose agents grow like yarrow from distinct roots, pay little; a sybil farm bleeds its stake with every clone.
